tagline: 尼康数码单反相机，1978 年发布
description: 尼康于1978年推出的数码单反相机。快门速度Electronic vertical metallic focal plane shutter, speeds: 1-1/2000 sec。

specs.卡口: Nikon F bayonet AI-s (compatible with Non-AI lenses)
specs.取景器: Fixed eye level pentaprism, 0.85x magnification, 92% frame coverage, needle match exposure meter displays shutter speed and small window displays lens aperture
specs.曝光测光: TTL center-weighted (60/40), meter activated by lightly pressing shutter release button, EV 1 - 18 at ISO 100, f 1.4
specs.快门: Electronic vertical metallic focal plane shutter, speeds: 1-1/2000 sec
specs.英文简介: The Nikon FE is a 35mmm SLR manual focus camera introduced by Nikon in 1978, as a compliment to the Nikon FM launched the previous year.
